title: sync: propagate the command timeout context to tag listing
body:
`skopeo sync --command-timeout` currently only covers the actual copies. Listing the tags of a repository goes through imagesToCopyFromRepo, which calls getImageTags with context.Background(), so the timeout never applies to that request — against a slow or unreachable registry, sync just sits there in "Getting tags" no matter what timeout was requested.

This threads the command context through imagesToCopy, imagesToCopyFromRegistry, filterSourceReferences and imagesToCopyFromRepo, so the tag listing is bounded by the same timeout and cancellation as everything else.

Nothing changes unless --command-timeout is set.
